description.en: Adds a player to a match-side roster by character ID string, assigning their field position and role. Looks up the character's data by CRC32 of the ID string; if found, registers it into the given team slot with the given position and role.
Index of the team/side to add the member to (e.g. 0 for the player's team).
Character ID string (e.g. "para_cp0032") used to look up the player's data.
Field position slot to place the member at.
Role assigned to the member (e.g. goalkeeper, forward).

True once the call has been processed (the member is only actually registered if charaId resolves to known character data; otherwise this is a silent no-op); null if fewer than 4 arguments were given or the call was otherwise invalid.

example.code:
// Register a player onto team 0's roster at position 1 with role 2
CMND_BTL_ADD_MEMBER(0, "para_cp0032", 1, 2);
